current.text: Ja Morant was traded to Portland. Jerome is Memphis's starting point guard and has started in the preseason. Memphis is giving him a big role.
He has had about 30 usage or more in every preseason game. In the first two preseason games he shot 50% but played only about 17 minutes a game.
Coach Tuomas Iisalo uses short, hard stints, keeps minutes down and runs an 11 or 12 man rotation. Joe expects only Cameron Boozer and Cedric Coward to top 30 minutes.
He should play more than last season's 23 minutes. Joe projects 27 to 28 minutes. The newest worry is high usage in only about 24 minutes. At 27 minutes his value could take off.
Last season's efficiency (about 70% true shooting and a 70% potential assist conversion) is not expected to last. His efficiency should fall, and last season's numbers came with heavy rest.

Experts take him around picks 74 to 80 and call him a target and possibly one of the best sleepers, unless he comes off the bench for 20 minutes. A Yahoo ADP of 115 is far too low. A top 15 category rank, as ESPN once gave him, is far too high.
He is healthy now. A calf injury cost him about three months last season. His missed games late in the season were tank rest.
At 29 he does not fit Memphis's young core, and Memphis could move off him. The team holds three 2027 first-round picks, which gives it room to make trades.
Memphis has a maxed 4-4-4 schedule in our playoff weeks 19 to 21 and only 13 back-to-backs, possibly the fewest in the league.

durable.text: He is an efficient scorer with an underrated handle and elite feel for angles, despite below-average athleticism.
His true level is roughly a 40 to 41% three-point shooter, not 44%.
Injuries ruined two of his last three seasons, and he has a concerning injury history.
He is a better category-league player than points-league player.
Blocks are his weak category, even for a guard.

note: Experts take him around picks 74 to 80. That makes him a top 100 player in our 144-player auction, yet Yahoo's average cost is only 1.3 USD (ESPN 6.0 USD), so a bid up to his Yahoo value of 11 USD looks fine. His projections give a guard with plus 3PM, AST, STL and FT% and almost no blocks, so he fits punt BLK and guard-heavy builds, and Memphis has a 4-4-4 playoff schedule. Early on, check whether he gets 27 or more minutes under Iisalo's short stints, whether his usage stays near 30, and whether he stays healthy.
